title: SaturatingAmplifier
text: Models a saturation amplifier, 1 input, 1 output, {VinVout} sets Input and corresponding output voltage responses N ×2 matrix; {Mode} sets the amplifier operating mode, {Specification} sets the input specification for limiting amplifier, {Limit} sets the clipping voltage for the limiting, {LinearGain} sets the amplifier gain in the linear region, {Slice select} selects which corner of 3D GPZ matrix and {Visualize Response} plots input vs output voltage response. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Specification
params.values: Input specification for limiting amplifier output ’Limit and Linear Gain’ (default) | ’VinVout’

params.name: Limit
params.values: Clipping voltage for the limiting amplifier 1.2 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: LinearGain
params.values: Amplifier gain in the linear region 1 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: VinVout
params.values: Input and corresponding output voltage responses N ×2 matrix | N ×2× M matrix

params.name: Slice select
params.values: Select which corner of 3D GPZ matrix to use 0 (default) | nonegative scalar integer

params.name: Visualize Response
params.values: Plot input vs output voltage response button
